items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: But Don used to say to me, we were friendly, he says, 'Look, Buddy,' he says, 'I know you're a friend of mine and I know you admire me and I admire you.'

ctx.x: Lester never said anything to you?

No, he never mentioned it. He never said anything to me about it, although when he came back in the band, he fired Don Byas and hired Prez again. But why he fired Don Byas, Don Byas pulled a pistol on all of us at -- Manhattan Hotel, it later became. But what was it then? Edison -- no, it wasn't Edison, it was Lincoln, Hotel Lincoln on 33rd and 8th Avenue. It was 33rd or 34. You know, right on -- it was later the Manhattan Hotel.
